messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning a dry-run rollout of the edge-serving kernel + new quant profile tonight 22:00 UTC. Need one owner for rollout and one for validation. Plan: 5% routing to a small pool, staged quant apply. Rollback if p95 > 120ms or errors > 0.5%.

jordan: I can own the rollout. I'll be online 21:30-23:30 UTC. Will take slot 3 in south-pool.

chao: I'll handle validation. Will run latency/error checks and KV sanity. Lina, can you watch logs/traces?

lina: Yep. I'll monitor logs + traces. Share the commands I should run.

maria: Commands:
```
deploy-bot start-rollout --env edge --version v3.2-kernel-bump --weight 5 --profile quant-x8
```
Rollback:
```
./scripts/rollback_edge.sh --to v3.1
```
Quick checks: `api.p95`, `api.errors.rate`, `cache.kv.miss_rate`.

devops-bot: Reminder: maintenance-window tag applied. Autoscale paused for window.

jordan: Will trigger `deploy-bot start-rollout` at 22:00 UTC.

chao: Validation plan:
1) Run synthetic load: `tools/smoke/edge_check.py` (10m)
2) Watch p95 and error rate; abort if thresholds hit
3) KV dump: `python tools/kv_check.py --prefix test-prefix`
4) Verify KV TTLs and prefix caching

lina: Tail logs: `kubectl logs -f deploy/edge-pool --since=10m | grep -E "(ERROR|WARN)"` and open traces for spikes.

maria: If rollback needed, jordan run `deploy-bot rollback --to v3.1` and post update to #eng-runtime and #incidents. Tag kernel PR for followup.

jordan: :thumbsup:

chao: One ask: apply quant profile staged in two steps (staged.json then production.json) to avoid OOM during init.

maria: Agreed. Steps:
`config apply --staged quant/edge/staged.json`
then
`config promote quant/edge/production.json`

lina: Creating a quick dashboard with api.p95, api.errors.rate, cache.kv.miss_rate, 2m refresh.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: rollout 1746123456 -> v3.2-kernel-bump, window 22:00-22:15 UTC, owner jordan, validator chao.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the runbook with notes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-kernel-rollout. Ping here for any changes.
